# pulse_consumer (Resource)

A durable pull consumer (explicit acknowledgement) on a stream. It keeps its position across restarts, so a tool resumes where it stopped.

A client may use a consumer when it holds a `durable` grant: the grant `{ action = "durable", name = "orders", subject = "evt.shop.>" }` lets client `X` bind to the consumer named `X_orders`, so name it `"${pulse_client.shop.id}_orders"`. Creating it here fixes its start position and filters ahead of time; the SDKs bind to an existing consumer.

Where it starts (`deliver_policy`, `opt_start_seq`, `opt_start_time`) cannot change; changing it replaces the consumer, which loses its position. Import with `<stream>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The shop's order processor replays every order event, then follows new ones, resuming where it stopped.
resource "pulse_client" "orders" {
  name = "order-processor"
  grants = [
    { action = "durable", subject = "evt.shop.order.>", name = "orders" },
  ]
}

resource "pulse_consumer" "orders" {
  stream           = "EVENTS"
  name             = "${pulse_client.orders.id}_orders" # what the client's durable grant allows
  filter_subjects  = ["evt.shop.order.>"]
  deliver_policy   = "by_start_time"
  opt_start_time   = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  ack_wait_seconds = 60
  max_deliver      = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter_subjects` (Set of String) Subjects the consumer delivers (wildcards allowed). Each must overlap the stream's subjects, and for a client's consumer stay within its `durable` grant's subject.
- `name` (String) Consumer (durable) name: letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 128. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `ack_wait_seconds` (Number) How long a delivered message may stay unacknowledged before it is redelivered. Default 30.
- `deliver_policy` (String) Where delivery starts: `all` (default, the whole history), `new`, `last`, `last_per_subject`, `by_start_sequence` (needs `opt_start_seq`) or `by_start_time` (needs `opt_start_time`). Changing it forces a new consumer.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `max_ack_pending` (Number) Maximum unacknowledged messages in flight; `-1` is unlimited. Default 1000.
- `max_deliver` (Number) Maximum delivery attempts per message; `-1` (the default) is unlimited.
- `opt_start_seq` (Number) First stream sequence for `by_start_sequence`. Changing it forces a new consumer.
- `opt_start_time` (String) Start time (RFC 3339) for `by_start_time`. Changing it forces a new consumer.
- `stream` (String) Stream, e.g. `EVENTS`. Changing it forces a new consumer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<stream>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pulse_consumer.orders EVENTS/<client_id>_orders
```
